summary: After gorilloids kill [[species:delta-eridani-natives|Deltans]] at a tribal hearth, [[character:bob-replicant]] and the other Bobs conclude that the dwindling Deltans cannot simply be left to extinction. They restore access to flint and prepare defensive drones, while [[character:archimedes]] turns the material into better tools and weapons. Better armed Deltans repel a later attack, and Archimedes improves thrown spears by adding a flint point, gaining an agreement to supply spear points in return for shares of future kills.

introducing.name: Moses
introducing.current_state: An elder Deltan whom [[character:bob-replicant]] calls Moses, teaching [[character:archimedes]] flintworking and agreeing to make spear points for the camp in return for a share of future kills.

introducing.name: Arnold
introducing.current_state: A notably imposing Deltan whom [[character:bob-replicant]] calls Arnold, supporting [[character:archimedes]] during the dispute over flint.

introducing.name: buster drone
introducing.description: A buster drone is an observation drone reinforced internally and fitted with twenty-pound steel caps at both ends. At the modest acceleration available to the drones, it is intended to deliver a cannonball-equivalent kinetic blow against a gorilloid.

introducing.name: pointy sticks
introducing.description: Pointy sticks are Deltan wooden weapons, improved by [[character:archimedes]] with straighter shafts and later flint points. They let defenders brace against charging gorilloids and can be thrown as spears when weighted at the point.

updates.description: An intelligent, fire-using native people of [[location:delta-eridani-4|Delta Eridani 4]], named Deltans by [[character:bob-replicant]]. They have bat- and pig-like faces, long spiderish limbs, brownish-gray to orangey-tan fur, patterned heads and mobile, expressive ears. They live in tribes with two genders and loose pairings. Armed only with clubs, rocks and pointed sticks, the small population is under pressure from larger gorilloid predators, and Bob's group is helping it regain flintworking and better defences.
